cohort: The study included 241 pregnant women aged 18 years and older who were admitted to the trauma unit of an Emergency Department between 2017 and 2020 following traumatic injuries.
finding: Advanced maternal age (older than 35 years), trauma in the third trimester, and abnormal obstetric ultrasonography findings were identified as significant risk factors predicting post-traumatic obstetric complications within the first 24 hours.
gest_age: mean gestational age at the time of trauma was 28.4 ± 6.8 weeks
